name: Alþingi
notes: 63 seats; parliamentary-group counts from the Alþingi open XML (althingi.is/altext/xml/thingmenn, each member's thingseta record), read 2026-11-04: 58 sitting members plus the 5 substitutes (varamenn) who hold seats of members on leave. Two members sit outside any group (Guðmundur Ingi Kristinsson, Jón Gnarr). The Left-Green Movement and the Socialist Party hold no seats since the November 2024 election, so no seat is lit.
